title: Energy Department guarantees $1.6B AEP transmission loan

sources.quote: AEP Transmission, a subsidiary of American Electric Power (Nasdaq: AEP) has closed on a $1.6 billion loan guarantee at a preferred interest rate from the U.S.

explain: The Energy Department guaranteed a $1.6 billion loan to AEP's transmission business to rebuild about 5,000 miles of power lines in five states, lowering AEP's borrowing cost as data centers drive up electricity demand.
